exposure: 25-gauge Whitacre spinal needle with a pencil point (Group A)
25-gauge Quincke spinal needle with a cutting bevel (Group B)
cohort: The study comprised 120 obstetric patients who were scheduled for elective-segment cesarean section.
finding: The pencil-point 25-G Whitacre spinal needle resulted in a significantly lower incidence of PDPH (3.3%) compared to the traditional 25-G Quincke needle (10.8%).
